analysis.title: The great tech reset
key_insights: The NDX fell about 6.1% over three sessions, its biggest three-day selloff since Liberation Day.
YTD performance is RSP +15%, Russell +13% and NDX +10%.
Equity vols have risen broadly, but tech vol rose the most. Tech went from all-time highs to high stress in under a month.
Hartnett's key levels to hold ahead of a possible year-end rally were MAGS $70 and SMH $520. Both have now broken.
VXN has tracked the widening in hyperscaler CDS spreads. The Market Ear argues heavy credit stress eventually pulls equity volatility higher in sympathy.
Privorotsky says anxiety about AI capex is at extreme levels as new bond issuance raises questions about the cost and availability of capital.
SOX trades at 12.16x blended 24-month forward earnings, below the Liberation Day and Iran escalation lows and near 2022 levels. Nvidia trades at 10x, its lowest multiple since 2013.
The market is questioning whether 2027 is peak earnings as financing constraints threaten the AI buildout.
BofA's Hartnett says US tech bonds are down 9% YTD, with performance relative to IG bonds at 30-year lows.
Hyperscaler debt issuance reached $182bn in 2026 versus $17bn in 2024. Hyperscaler equity issuance of $89bn suggests the era of large tech buybacks may be ending.
Hartnett sees value in Mag7 bonds yielding 6-8%. The Market Ear suggests risk/reward may be shifting from equity to credit in the capital structure.

sector_views.rationale: The report documents a sharp tech selloff, rising tech volatility, widening hyperscaler CDS spreads and AI capex financing concerns, but also presents a bull case that AI adoption is early. It does not state a formal sector rating.
Hartnett sees Mag7 bond yields of 6-8% as attractive after tech bonds underperformed IG at 30-year lows.

earnings_insights: Privorotsky: the market is questioning whether 2027 is peak earnings as financing constraints threaten the AI buildout. SOX at 12.16x blended 24-month forward earnings and Nvidia at 10x are forward multiples, not reported results.

trade_ideas.description: Buy Mag7 / hyperscaler bonds yielding 6-8%, shifting risk/reward from equity to credit.
trade_ideas.rationale: Tech bonds are down 9% YTD with relative performance versus IG at 30-year lows, and Mag7 yields of 6-8% look attractive.

risk_factors: Rising hyperscaler debt issuance ($182bn in 2026) raises questions about the cost and availability of capital.
Financing constraints could limit the AI buildout and cap 2027 earnings.
Capacity expanding faster than demand can absorb it.
Hyperscaler equity issuance of $89bn suggests tech buybacks may fade.
Widening hyperscaler CDS spreads may pull equity volatility higher.

tension_points.bull_case: AI adoption remains in its infancy, and the valuation reset (SOX at 12.16x, Nvidia at 10x) may be a generational buying opportunity.
tension_points.bear_case: Capacity is expanding faster than demand can absorb it, and financing constraints could make 2027 peak earnings, starting a larger earnings reset.
tension_points.what_invalidates: 2027 marking peak earnings as financing constraints threaten the AI buildout.
